epoch_basis: 17 = floor(28,800 / 1,618.2190406250302), declared in thinking §14.8; same epoch count in all three conditions.
answer_success_bar: At least 9 of 10 trainings bind all four held-out rows correctly.
chain_bar: Every question opens an episode; successor chain length equals the second addend; one inference row per step with correct provenance.
expectation_only_bar: Report how many of the ten form the chain without the answer line or answer loss.
zero_budget_bar: Report held-out binding accuracy of ten trainings with attentionBudget zero.
measurement: After development certificates, freeze source and helpers; one complete green sweep, thinking 57/57, unchanged standing thirty, and all thirty math trainings exactly once. Preserve every outcome. No selection of seeds or retries.
runtime: Ordinary source-text sentence driver and shared chooser. Arithmetic, worked-step generation and expected answers are data/verifier only; no definition rows, plus executor, numeric numeral encoding or mathRange-sized answer head.
publication: Stop for Claude review before any learning-step commit.
initialization: Ten fresh entropy-initialized states, each replayed across the three conditions; no chosen seed or outcome-dependent redraw.
paired_presentations: Each run owns seventeen fresh presentations, graded by successor-chain length; counting facts first, premise-only questions before one successor, then two, and so on. Original within-document premise shuffling is retained. The same presentations serve all three conditions, with only answer lines and labels removed for expectation-only.

resource_limits.timeout_basis: Live §14.8: 24-hour wall timeout covers two concurrent workers; the 17-epoch declaration comes from an eight-hour per-training development-time budget.

verifier: Strict bound lexical identity; a chain requires one committed inference per successor, the licensing counting fact and its premise/prior-inference dependency. Surface answers and raw operation counts do not satisfy the gate.
zero_budget_semantics: Ordinary word/VP composition remains active; bracket narrowing and thought work receive zero allowance. Model loading and a real optimizer pass certify this control.
scoring: Only the binding read back from the committed LTM row is scored. Ephemeral conclusions, surface strings and nearest-numeral guesses do not count.
sentence_departure_judgement: R + A; expectation trains predictors through the existing owner-step registry and does not enter this comparison.
local_thought_work: Existing metered thought-walk cost, as §14.3; no work term added to the sentence judgement.

reporting.greedy_what: Per start, first and all first-epoch greedy question closings, read before commit from the already executed greedy trial. No probe changes the policy.
reporting.episodes: Per epoch and sentence kind: counts, episode share, total and mean kept-episode work. Partial failed batches retained separately.
reporting.binding_verifier: binding-answers-frozen.diff and binding-answers-verifier.json: references() and matches() byte-identical to the original frozen source. Only loss-side cost changes authorized by §14.7.2.
reporting.heldout: Only completed seventeen-epoch trainings are evaluated and reported. All attempt outcomes are retained.
